page.overview:
What is Bread?

Bread is a food item that can be eaten by the player.

Novice-level farmer villagers sell 6 bread for one emerald as part of their trades. they only have a 40% chance of offering this trade.

Farmer villagers may use wheat they have harvested to craft bread, which they can trade with other villagers.

Farmer villagers may throw bread at players under the Hero of the Village effect.
